errors.text_span: The chart is divided into ten distinct slices
errors.evidence: The chart actually contains 13 slices, not 10.
The description fails to list all 13 slices shown in the chart. It omits 'SCIFACT' (0.1%) and 'MULTIFC' (0.5%). The prompt requires describing each slice.
XSUMHUL, at 1.6%, is not the smallest slice. Several slices are smaller, with SCIFACT being the smallest at 0.1%.
The description lists slices in a generally descending order of size, but incorrectly places 'MULTINLI' (11.3%) before 'VITAMINC' (13.0%) in this sequence.
The color of the 'SCITAIL' slice is a light green or lime green, not dark green. The adjacent 'FACTCC' slice is a darker shade of green.
The color of the 'PUBHEALTH' slice is a yellowish-khaki color, not light pink.
